mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, the Federal Reserve is expected to initiate monetary easing, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (both rising above their 3-month moving averages) signals robust consumer spending, which drives corporate earnings growth and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST MoM growth >= 0.5% and RSAFS MoM growth >= 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show MoM growth >= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a deceleration in industrial production growth (INDPRO growth rate falling below 0.5% annually) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO annual growth rate < 0.5% and the regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2% (annualized) signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDP growth (annualized) exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.5%) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a stimulative monetary policy environment in response to weak labor markets, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals increasing manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO shows month-over-month growth.
